target_customer: Frontier AI labs that train agents with reinforcement learning, buying licensed or custom RL environments and data licenses
problem: Most RL training teaches models to match human experts on text and code, but much real-world signal is numeric streams that change over time. Labs lack graded environments where data arrives on a clock and actions are scored against what actually happened.
business_model: License RL environments, build custom environments, and license data (usage terms not published)
product_category: RL environments and evals for frontier AI labs

founders.name: Antanas Žilinskas
previous_startups: Entangl (YC S24), co-founder and CTO, current outcome not checked
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is a published time-series researcher, first author of two ICLR 2026 papers on rare-event forecasting, and previously simulated superconductors at CERN and led a student rocket project.

competitors.name: HUD
competitors.what: Agentic evals and RL environments for computer use agents, sold to frontier labs

competitors.name: Bespoke Labs
competitors.what: Simulated worlds and sandboxes for training agents
competitors.funding_then: Reported $40M raise in one blog, not cross-checked

competitors.name: Mechanize, Prime Intellect, Plato, Fleet AI
competitors.what: Environment-first startups and open ecosystems listed in a vendor guide to RL environment companies

technical_complexity.rationale: Environments stream real de-identified records on a clock and grade by realized outcomes, which needs data access, simulation infrastructure and benchmark design. The founder has ICLR 2026 time-series papers and the company reports a lift from 25.6% to 39.5% full-solve rate after training an open model, a claim from its own YC profile.

defensibility.rationale: Real de-identified record sources could become a data moat, but environments are bought per project, labs can build in-house, and the field has many funded vendors as of 2026.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell. Sources describe consolidation in the environment layer and large labs weighing in-house builds.

market_need_then: Frontier labs were investing heavily in RL environments by 2026 according to an investor note, and reports describe a growing set of YC-backed environment startups with strong revenue.

branding.name_origin: The company site defines the name as to make something abstract into something real, matching the word reify.
branding.domain_note: Uses reific.co, not an exact .com (site fetched 2026).

identity.visual_style: Minimal clean layout centered on a leaderboard and research posts
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, plain and direct, focused on real records and graded outcomes

branding.brand_signature: Superhuman reasoning over time tagline and Timestep environment family names

brand_strength.rationale: A coherent name and tagline but no press, community or merch found yet; the company is weeks old.

outcome_analysis: Reific is a one-person Fall 2026 company active in the RL environment market that frontier labs were funding heavily. Its edge is real streaming records plus a researcher founder, but defensibility is thin because labs can build in-house and several funded vendors exist. No outcome exists yet, so these factors are provisional.
notes: Funding searches found no coverage of any round; the site says only Backed by Y Combinator. Outcome searches found nothing about the company. Competitors are 2026 sources not tied to an exact month. Team size 1 per YC.
